snippet.title: PAYDAY: Aces High - Release Date Trailer (Meta Quest, SteamVR, Steam Frame)
snippet.description:
It's time to put the mask on... PAYDAY: Aces High launches November 5 on Meta Quest, SteamVR & Steam Frame - Wishlist Now!

Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players.

Join the Playtest on Meta Quest or play the Steam Demo before Oct 26 to receive the exclusive Kitty Mask in the full game:

💥 Meta Quest:
https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/payday-aces-high/9059428207447106/
💥 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3456660/PAYDAY_Aces_High/

The trailer was made by the ever-so-awesome Demo Akuro: https://demoakuro.com/
